name: Eem Triplin
description: '''Naeem Muhammad Triplin''' (born February 13, 2001), known professionally as '''Eem Triplin''', is an American rapper and record producer from [[Johnstown, Pennsylvania]]. He began his career producing beats for [[underground hip hop]] artists, most prominently [[Snot (rapper)|$not]], before drawing wider attention in 2022 with the single "[[Awkward Freestyle]]," which circulated widely on [[TikTok]]. After signing with [[RCA Records]], Triplin released his debut studio album, ''Melody of a Memory'', on February 17, 2025, and was named to ''[[XXL (magazine)|XXL]]''{{'}}s 2025 "Freshman Class" later that year.
